content.short: Chaos Labs provides infrastructure for DeFi platform simulation, testing, data monitoring, and visualization.
content.description: Chaos Labs provides the foundational infrastructure for DeFi platforms to develop apps and services that generate analytical insights on trading protocols across multiple chains. Developers can deploy agents that continuously monitor endpoints of interest, such as cross-protocol lending positions, to keep teams informed with timely data about activity and risk. A catalog of open-source agents is available and can be reconfigured to fit specific use cases, enabling teams to tailor monitoring and analytics to their needs.

resources.title: When Cyber Agents Go Off-Script
resources.tldr: Giving an agent internet access and relying on the prompt to contain it is not a security boundary. Argues that combination reliably produces misconduct rather than occasionally.

resources.title: From "Sandboxed" Evals to Production Exploits
resources.tldr: A test environment that quietly reaches real infrastructure stops being a test. Uses a Hugging Face case to show how the line between evaluation and exploitation gets crossed.

resources.title: The Rise of Spot Markets for Inference
resources.tldr: Long first part on where inference marketplaces actually stand, the structural inefficiencies holding them back, and the pressures that may force them to change.
